Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

IS : 7041 • 1973 

2.1 Tolerances on untoleranced dimensions shall be In accordance with the best prevalent manufacturing 
practice. 

2.2 The nose shall be so designed as to accept square taper tang of bits ( see IS : 6891-1973 Speci- 
fication for carpenters' auger bits ). 

3. Designation — A carpenter's plain brace of nominal size 300 mm shall be designated as: 

Brace 300, IS : 7041 

4. Material and Other Requirements — According to IS : 7025* ' Technical supply conditions 
for carpenters' braces '. 

5. Marking — Braces shall be marked with nominal size, manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade-mark and the year of manufacture. 

5.1 ISI Certification l\/larking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New 
Delhi 110001. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While preparing this standard assistance has been derived from BS 1978 : 1965 ' Bit braces ' 
issued bfy British Standards Institution and the information supplied by Chief Inspectorate of General 
Stores, Kanpur.
